_metadata.description: Uniform decomposition of any track into embeddings, structure, tempo, key, loudness, tags, notation, and lyrics.

requirements.title: One decomposition contract for owned and generated audio
requirements.description: A single analyze contract returns the same structured description regardless of provenance, so generated tracks are rankable and searchable on identical footing with owned ones.

validation.notes: Analysis is explicitly out of scope for this composition plan

requirements.title: Dual embedding space
requirements.description: Analysis emits both an audio-text embedding (enabling natural-language retrieval over audio) and a music-specific embedding (encoding tonal, rhythmic, and structural character); consumers may request either or both.

validation.notes: Analysis is explicitly out of scope for this composition plan

requirements.title: Embeddings are stored pooled, not frame-level
requirements.description: Persisted embeddings are pooled or segment-level by default. Frame-level output is produced only on explicit request for a single track and is never written to the library index, because frame-level storage is roughly four orders of magnitude larger per track.

validation.notes: Analysis is explicitly out of scope for this composition plan

requirements.title: Structure, beats, tempo, and key with disagreement recorded
requirements.description: Analysis returns section boundaries and labels, beats and downbeats, tempo, and key. Where independent estimators are available, their disagreement is stored alongside the consensus value, because disagreement is itself a meaningful signal about rubato and tonal ambiguity.

validation.notes: Analysis is explicitly out of scope for this composition plan

requirements.title: Notation and lyric extraction
requirements.description: Audio-to-MIDI notation runs per separated stem rather than on the full mix, and lyric transcription uses a model tuned for sung vocals rather than general speech.

validation.notes: Analysis is explicitly out of scope for this composition plan
